title: OIT Clinical Data Mart Operations and Maintenance (CDM)
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE.DIVISION OF ACQUISITIONS POLICY HQ
description_text:
The purpose of this requirement is to provide support and maintenance (including minor enhancements) of existing and to be developed data marts:

-Provide Data Mart Operations and Maintenance.

-Develop Business Intelligence/Analytic solutions (dashboards, scorecards, etc.).

-Prepare and Publish User Reports.

-Answer Customer Inquiries, provide Technical Assistance and guidance as needed & furnish complete responses to ad hoc Report Requests.

-Provide timely, culturally appropriate customer service and/or presentations as needed to IHS and Tribal staff.

-Provide Data Quality Assurance processes.

-Develop, test and assist with training and implementation of New or Enhancements to Existing Data Marts.

-Conform to Program/Project Management Processes.

-Prepare and Maintain Data Mart Documentation.

-Ensure Security Compliance in accordance with all IHS and Federal Regulations.
